title: RBI One-Time Approval Proposal for MFs & Insurers to Acquire up to 10% Bank Shareholding
summary: Replaces repeated prior approval requirement for qualifying institutional investors acquiring >5% bank stakes.

blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI One-Time Approval Proposal for MFs & Insurers to Acquire up to 10% Bank Shareholding. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Replaces repeated prior approval requirement for qualifying institutional investors acquiring >5% bank stakes.
One-Time Approval: One-time RBI clearance covers future acquisitions up to 10% voting rights/share capital.
Qualifying Entities: SEBI-registered MFs, IRDAI-registered Insurers, PFRDA-registered Pension Funds.
Standard approval threshold (5%) vs one-time clearance cap (10%).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on statutory circular guidelines, compliance deadlines, penal provisions, and applicability thresholds across scheduled banks.
